messages:
olga_finance: FYI AcmeHealth flagged their March private (VPC) invoice — platform fee line is ~45% higher than last month, asking for explanation and potential credit.
invoicer-bot: Invoice #AH-2026-03 generated 2026-03-02 08:12 UTC, platform_fee: $39,420, support_tier: enterprise, meter_snap: vpc-456-prod.
kevin_billing: copying the ticket here — FIN-4521. Did their committed capacity or SKU change during the month?
tara_acct_mgr: Not that i'm aware of. Last renewal kept same support tier and reserved capacity. I chatted with their AM — they didn't request changes.
sam_engops: I'll pull the metering export for vpc-456-prod. Can you confirm the date window and which metrics we compare (gpu_hours vs platform_fee buckets)?
olga_finance: Compare calendar March (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31). Primary suspect: duplicate platform fee application when node resize happened (customer reported a brief burst on 2026-03-11).
kevin_billing: If it's a duplicate platform fee charge we need legal/contract check but can issue a provisional credit pending investigation. What's the estimate on credit amount if duplicate?
tara_acct_mgr: AM suggests ~ $12k gap based on their expected math. They want an ETA for resolution before renewal conversation next week.
sam_engops: grabbing logs now. quick query: `SELECT sum(platform_fee_applied) FROM billing_events WHERE resource='vpc-456-prod' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31';` will confirm.
sam_engops: got result — two distinct platform_fee events on 2026-03-11 for the same billing window (ids bf-9921 and bf-9922). Looks like one triggered by resize job and one by monthly rollup.
kevin_billing: ok that explains the ~45% bump. We should draft a provisional credit equal to bf-9922 amount and tag invoice as disputed. Approvals?
olga_finance: Finance approves provisional credit up to $13,000 for customer goodwill while engineering confirms root cause. Please attach exact amount and GL code.
sam_engops: engineering root cause: resize job didn't set `rollup_exempt=true` due to a regression in the billing hook. PR to fix and a backfill job to remove duplicate events queued. Ticket ENG-BILL-197 open.
tara_acct_mgr: I'll tell the customer we're pausing collection on the disputed line, issuing provisional credit, and will confirm final numbers after the backfill (ETA 48 hrs). They want a short note for their procurement team.
kevin_billing: action items: 1) finance to approve provisional credit (olga) 2) eng to run backfill and provide final delta (sam) 3) account to send customer comms (tara) 4) billing to attach credit memo to AH-2026-03 (kevin).
olga_finance: Approved. Please set provisional_credit_amount: "$12,450" and GL: "CU-CR-PRV". Finance will review final adjustment before posting.
sam_engops: Backfill job started (job id: backfill-2179). I'll post status updates here.
tara_acct_mgr: Draft message to customer: "We've paused collection on the disputed platform fee line and created a provisional credit of $12,450 while we complete a brief engineering backfill. We'll confirm final adjustment within 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption." Approve?
kevin_billing: approve. Also include a note that renewal conversations won't be affected by provisional credit.
sam_engops: backfill finished — removed duplicate event bf-9922, delta matches provisional credit $12,450. ENG-BILL-197 marked resolved.
kevin_billing: closing dispute. will issue credit memo CM-AH-2026-03-1 for $12,450 and attach to AH-2026-03. Move invoice to status: adjusted.
olga_finance: once credit memo posts, send reconciliation note and GL posting. Finance will sign off on final ledger entry.
tara_acct_mgr: customer replied "Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround." Closing loop on my side.
kevin_billing: filing postmortem action: add test coverage to billing hook for resize flow, update runbook for provisional credits. Tagging owners: sam_engops (eng), olga_finance (finance).
olga_finance: thanks everyone. FIN-4521 -> resolved."
